messages:
Asha (Finance): Heads-up: reseller 'GlobalResell' applied a 20% withholding VAT on their AWS Marketplace payment for Apr instead of providing exemption documentation. They say AWS invoiced them gross, but their finance team withheld tax at source and is refusing to pay the net amount. They want a corrected invoice or a proof of zero-rating.
Farah (Partner Success): Oof. Partner sent payment but short-paid by 20% on INV-89477 and put AR on dispute. They want us to issue a corrected invoice with VAT = 0% or provide a tax residency certificate to get the withheld portion released.
Priya (Accounting): Can you paste the invoice lines? Also, do we have any tax handling notes in the resale contract? We need to know whether Redwood is treated as the supplier or AWS is the supplier for tax.
Asha (Finance): Invoice extract: 
```
invoice_id,sku,desc,qty,unit_price,ext_amount,vat
INV-89477,ML-API-UNIT,ml inference units,5000,0.05,250.00,50.00
TOTAL,, , , ,250.00,50.00
```
Partner recorded payment: 200.00 (withheld 50.00).
Miguel (Tax): For AWS Marketplace, tax treatment depends on marketplace model (reseller vs marketplace facilitator) and the customer's jurisdiction. If AWS is the supplier in the flow, we typically don't issue VAT. But partner says AWS invoiced gross to them; we may need AWS invoice copy. Ask partner for AWS invoice PDF and withholding certificate.
aws-marketplace-bot: Automated: AWS settlement for account globalresell-acct on 2026-04-15 shows invoice AWS-2026-04-15-5567 issued to GlobalResell. Case opened with AWS tax team: 05-111222.
Farah (Partner Success): Asked partner for the AWS invoice and their withholding tax certificate. They replied with AWS invoice PDF and note: "We withheld VAT under local law, will release if vendor provides tax residency or corrected invoice."
Asha (Finance): Proposal: 1) Request AWS invoice confirming supplier; 2) If AWS is supplier, we provide partner with a letter confirming Redwood is downstream reseller and not the billed supplier; 3) Place INV-89477 on AR hold for 10 business days while AWS confirms. Any objections?
Priya (Accounting): For AR hold >$1k we need manager sign-off. Amount withheld here is $50, total invoice $300 (including VAT). Threshold not exceeded but still want manager loop for tax docs. Also we should record a short-payment memo in AR. GL: hold note, no provisional credit.
Miguel (Tax): If AWS confirms they are the invoiced supplier, partner should coordinate with AWS for refund of withheld tax; we can provide a vendor declaration but shouldn't issue a credit we don't owe. If Redwood is shown as supplier on AWS invoice, we need to correct our invoice.
Lina (Finance Manager): Approve AR hold and request AWS invoice copy + partner withholding certificate. Approve: Lina +1.
Asha (Finance): Created FIN ticket FIN-3309 and attached partner AWS invoice + withholding notice. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-3309. Added 10-business-day follow-up.
Farah (Partner Success): Sent partner confirmation: "We've placed INV-89477 on hold while we validate with AWS tax team. Please share any supporting docs; we'll follow up." Partner replied: "Thanks, will coordinate with AWS and send docs."
aws-marketplace-bot: AWS case 05-111222 created; awaiting AWS tax team response (3-7 business days).
Priya (Accounting): Logged AR short-pay note and will not escalate to collections while FIN-3309 is open.
Asha (Finance): Will post updates when AWS responds. Thread closed for now. :white_check_mark:
